description: decode_request(RouteRequest, body). expect.result is decoded, malformed (a JSON syntax error, including NaN and Infinity: HTTP 400 invalid_json) or invalid (a schema error: HTTP 422 invalid_json). The CLI reports both errors on stderr as 'invalid request: ' with exit 2. The limit-* items, sized around the Python router's former parser limits, put the value at tool_call.input, inside six enclosing levels (object, conversation array, message, parts array, part, tool_call)
